items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I really liked his playing, but I never tried to copy his playing... I played it practically note for note like Trumbauer did.

ctx.x: What did Mutt think about Bix Beiderbecke? Did he ever...

Mutt didn't think about nobody but himself! [LAUGHS] But believe me, everybody else did. In fact, you listen to that record, and they've got a hellified solo, Frankie Trumbauer, on "Singin' The Blues." [SINGS REFRAIN FROM SOLO] And Alex Hill...
